faq.a: We are located at Bansal Avenue, Shop No. 8, Gat No. 1624, Near IIBM College, Opposite Chikli Town Hall, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune - 411062.

faq.q: Do you serve 100% pure vegetarian & Jain options?
faq.a: Yes! Cauvery is strictly 100% Pure Vegetarian. We offer dedicated Jain preparation (no onion, no garlic, no root vegetables) for all our idlis, plain & cheese dosas, and chutneys.
We are open 7 days a week from 7:00 AM in the morning to 11:00 PM at night. Hot breakfast, lunch meals, evening snacks, and late dinners are available throughout the day.

faq.q: Is parking available for cars and two-wheelers?
faq.a: Yes, ample customer parking is available right in front of Bansal Avenue and opposite Chikli Town Hall.

faq.q: How can I order online or book a table?
faq.a: You can assemble your dishes directly using our one-click WhatsApp Cart on this website, or call us directly. Table reservations for families and groups can be booked seamlessly via the booking form.

reviews.name: Dr. Rohit Deshmukh
reviews.review: Hands down the best Mysore Masala Dosa in Pimpri Chinchwad! The crispness of the dosa and that fiery red garlic chutney reminds me of CTR Bangalore. The brass davara filter coffee was heavenly.

reviews.name: Sneha Kulkarni
reviews.review: As students right next door at IIBM, Cauvery is our daily hangout. The Ghee Podi Thatte Idli melts in your mouth and the student discount is a lifesaver. Fast service and super hygienic!

reviews.name: Anand & Priya Iyer
reviews.review: Being authentic Tamilians living in Pune, we are very picky about sambar and filter coffee. Cauvery's sambar is aromatic without unnecessary sugar, and the coconut chutney is ground fresh. 10/10 experience!

reviews.name: Vikram Shinde
reviews.review: Drove from Hinjawadi on Sunday just for their 2.5-foot Paper Roast Dosa. Totally worth the drive! The ambience is warm and modern, not cramped like typical tiffin joints.
